data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 273.46m. During 2018 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year strengthening of GBP 35.579m (13.02% of opening reserves) driven by adverse claims development, including impacts from natural catastrophe-related losses and movements in reinsurance recoveries. The movement is explicitly recorded in the technical provisions movement note and the syndicate also references settled hurricane losses (Harvey, Irma and Maria) which led to cash calls on the 2016 and 2017 years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding) prior-year comparative column. Prior-year development (35.579m) taken from 'Change in prior year provisions' gross column in the Technical Provisions movement table. The narrative sentence quoted for exact_reserve_text reports the NET adverse movement (GBP 22.1m); the gross movement is taken from the technical provisions table. The class-level movement amounts listed in note 6 are presented net of reinsurance in the note; these are used for lob_movements but are net values as printed. A gross claims development triangle (gross) is present in the claims development note and was used to capture development rows. Cash calls relating to hurricane settlements are quantified elsewhere in the report but not allocated to individual hurricanes in the text; amounts were therefore not attributed to specific named events.
